requirements.note: Meta rule on how SDKs are judged; nothing to implement.

Spans and logs go as OTLP/HTTP JSON to /v1/traces and /v1/logs, but replay chunks are a custom JSON body ({session_id, seq, started_at, ended_at, events}) POSTed to a non-OTLP path /v1/replay/chunks (port 4319 by default).
Custom events use unprefixed non-OTel names `navigation`, `web_vital`, `http.request.failed`; most custom attributes are ouo.-prefixed.
Does not replace a host's already-registered global tracer/logger provider, propagator or context manager (setGlobal* returns false), but registers its own globally by default with no opt-out.
No getTracerProvider/getLoggerProvider on the RUM instance; hosts reach the providers only through the OTel globals, and only if the SDK won the global registration.
No metrics SDK dependency or /v1/metrics exporter; only traces and logs.
Events go through the Logs API with eventName; documentLoad and fetch/XHR instrumentations are configured with ignoreNetworkEvents and ignorePerformancePaintEvents so no span events are added.

Instance methods are wrapped in attempt() and never throw (test/safety.test.ts); SSR returns an inert instance; but there is no pre-init API surface, methods after shutdown still write localStorage, and initRUM itself throws on missing endpoint/projectId/projectToken.
flush/shutdown return promises; no API waits on network; only synchronous localStorage access.
addEvent accepts any name including session.* and ouo.* and any attribute names; nothing is rejected or counted.

Web and RN share initRUM/RUM names, but the surface differs from the spec: initRUM, captureError, addEvent, endSession, setRoute, session.id(); no getSessionId, restartSession, setConsent, setGlobalAttributes, recordEvent, recordException, trackNavigation, replay.start/stop/capture.
No trackNavigation; setRoute only renames app.screen.name on later records and emits no navigation; no ouo.view.id exists.
captureError sets ouo.exception.kind=captured and ouo.exception.handled=true; ouo.exception.source is never set.
initRUM throws on a missing endpoint, projectId or projectToken (test/safety.test.ts 'a configuration error still throws'); other options are not validated or defaulted with a diagnostic.
Rates outside [0,1] behave as clamped (rate>=1 true, <=0 false), but inactivity and max-duration timeouts are used unclamped.
The credential is only an Authorization header, never in URLs or records; the debug init log prints projectId but not the token. (Stored requests in IndexedDB keep the header.)

architecture_notes: Built on the OTel JS SDK: WebTracerProvider and LoggerProvider with custom processors (session stamping, session sampling, a page-lifetime Batcher), OTel fetch/XHR/document-load instrumentations, web-vitals and rrweb. Telemetry is serialised with the OTel JSON serializers and sent by a custom Delivery layer (gzip via CompressionStream, retry with equal-jitter backoff, keepalive budget at page hide, optional beacon, IndexedDB offline store with memory fallback drained by later pages under a Web Lock). Session state is a JSON record in localStorage (UUID id, lastActivity, sampling decisions, replay seq) shared by storage events; device.id and an anonymous user.id are also persisted and sent by default. Replay is rrweb loaded lazily; events are chunked (5 s / 256 KB) into a custom JSON document {session_id, seq, started_at, ended_at, events} POSTed to /v1/replay/chunks on a separate receiver (port 4319), not OTLP; a BroadcastChannel lease makes tabs take turns on one session-wide sequence. Biggest structural gaps: replay is not OTLP and has no replay/stream/segment identity, keyframe flags, sha256, end records or persist-before-send; no ouo.view.id; MVP signal names (web_vital, navigation, event.name, ouo.rage_click, click spans) instead of the spec's events; scope and schema_url wrong; no consent, beforeSend, URL sanitising or bypass set for unsampled errors; sampling hash differs from the hex-prefix rule; no ouo.sdk.dropped or self-disable; initRUM throws on bad config.
